scope.summary: Implement the region stiffness/thickness override system (CG-06, MD Seam Taping + Bond + Skive + Strengthen): mask-scoped compliance and thickness overrides on panel regions/segments with typed presets (Fusible x4, Reinforcement x2, custom), a soften mode (Skive 0-100%), and a temporary Strengthen toggle (incl. partial region), applied in the solver as per-particle/per-constraint compliance scaling per Section 13.5/13.3.
acceptance_criteria: RegionStiffnessOverride record (segment span or painted vertex mask; mode Tape|Bond|Skive|Strengthen; preset ref or custom factors; extend mode None|ToOutline|ToTaping for tapes) persisted on the garment and versioned.
Solver applies overrides as compliance/thickness multipliers at constraint build time; Strengthen is runtime-toggleable without garment mutation (SimRunParams list).
Seeded presets: 4 fusible interfacing + 2 reinforcement presets with calibration JSON (drape-test evidence per 13.5 preset discipline).
Skive softens (compliance increase + thickness decrease) with strength 0-100%; overrides compose with per-panel material assignment (MT-375) deterministically (documented precedence).
FABRIC_PROPERTIES_IN_RANGE validation covers overridden effective values.
scope.risk_if_missed: Interfacing/taping is how collars, plackets, and waistbands hold shape; without region stiffness overrides tailored garments read as limp cloth and MD parity fails on every structured garment.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the full Fabric group with unit-bearing SI/f64 material authority, orthotropic coupon calibration, strain/friction/thickness semantics, backend-specific compilation, and versioned behavioral parity evidence.
